from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section4Scene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # Background and Title
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=32, color="#FFFFFF").to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # Left-side lecture content
        lecture_texts = []
        for line in lecture_lines:
            t = Text(line, font_size=24, color="#FFFFFF")
            lecture_texts.append(t)
            
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        
        # Grid System for Right Side
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]
        
        # Centering the grid on the right half of the screen
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Adjusting coordinates for the right side (x: 1 to 6, y: 2 to -3)
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.9
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.9
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup
        self.setup_layout(
            "Understanding Binomial Distributions",
            [
                "- n: Number of trials",
                "- p: Probability of success",
                "- k: Number of successes",
                "- Trials are independent",
                "- Formula: P(X=k) = (n choose k) * p^k * (1-p)^(n-k)"
            ]
        )
        
        self.play(Write(self.title))
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture, shift=RIGHT))
        self.wait(1)

        # 2. Visualizing a Trial (Grid Interaction)
        # Success (Green)
        success_node = Circle(radius=0.35, color="#00FF00", fill_opacity=0.8)
        success_label = Text("S", font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        success_grp = VGroup(success_node, success_label)
        
        # Failure (Red)
        failure_node = Circle(radius=0.35, color="#FF0000", fill_opacity=0.8)
        failure_label = Text("F", font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        failure_grp = VGroup(failure_node, failure_label)

        # Place nodes on grid to demonstrate "n" trials
        trials = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "B1", "B2", "B3"]
        trial_outcomes = ["S", "F", "S", "S", "F", "S"]
        
        mobjects_to_show = []
        for pos, outcome in zip(trials, trial_outcomes):
            if outcome == "S":
                obj = success_grp.copy()
            else:
                obj = failure_grp.copy()
            self.place_at_grid(obj, pos)
            mobjects_to_show.append(obj)

        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m) for m in mobjects_to_show], lag_ratio=0.2))
        self.wait(1)

        # 3. Highlight Probability Formula
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(X=k) = \\binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}",
            color="#FFFF00",
            font_size=36
        )
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "E3", scale_factor=1.2)
        # Shift slightly for better visibility
        formula.shift(RIGHT * 1.5)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.play(Indicate(formula, color="#FFFF00"))
        
        # 4. Final Scene Transition
        rect = Rectangle(color="#00FFFF", height=2.5, width=4.5)
        self.place_at_grid(rect, "D3")
        rect.shift(RIGHT * 1.5 + DOWN * 0.5)
        
        self.play(Create(rect))
        self.wait(2)
